bio.text: Darializa Avila Chevalier won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for New York's 13th Congressional District, defeating incumbent Adriano Espaillat, and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
According to her campaign website, she moved uptown to attend Columbia University 14 years ago, and is a PhD student at CUNY and an investigator at a public defender's office in Harlem.
According to her campaign website, she previously worked at Families for Freedom and has taught college courses at CUNY Lehman, Columbia and NYU.
